name: Badain Jaran Desert - Towers of Sand and Lakes
description: In the Alashan Plateau of northwestern China, the Badain Jaran Desert packs towering sand mega-dunes around a scattering of lakes. Its tallest stabilized dune rises about 460 metres from base to crest, the highest of its kind anywhere. Between the dunes, spring-fed lakes shimmer, some fresh and some very salty, and in places the dry sand hums when the wind moves across it.
